description: Erection of a single storey side extension and single storey rear infill extension, and installation of two front roof lights, two rear roof lights and two roof lights to the two storey rear outrigger.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (804 (Rev B); 807 (Rev C)  Received:  13 April 2021;  805 (Rev A); 806 (Rev B); 808 (Rev B)  Received:  12 April 2021;
800; 801; 802; 803 Received:  23 February 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the single storey side extension and single storey rear infill extension hereby approved.
